import importlib.util,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('scripts/experiments/prepare_a1_runtime_install.py')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('runtime_install_identity',p)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
protocol=json.loads(Path('docs/experiments/results/b2-semantic-transfer-001/protocol.json').read_text())
roots={'historical':Path('.venv'),'isolated':Path('artifacts/a1-runtime-001/runtime-v1.3-001/venv')}
actual={name:m.tree_identity(path) for name,path in roots.items()}
expected=protocol['runtime']['trees']
result={'schema':'nisayon.clean-dev-preservation.v1','trees':actual,'match_frozen_protocol':{name:actual[name]==expected[name] for name in roots},'historical_lock_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path('artifacts/clean-dev-001/before/uv.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'development_lock_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path('uv.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
Path('artifacts/clean-dev-001/preservation.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
assert all(result['match_frozen_protocol'].values())
